name: GCC Data Protection Frameworks
description: Gulf Cooperation Council data protection and AI governance frameworks, including UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45/2021 on Personal Data Protection and Saudi Arabia PDPL

policies.requirement_ref: UAE PDPL Article 22 / Saudi PDPL Article 29 - Data localization
policies.requirement_description: Personal data may be subject to localization requirements. Transfer outside the jurisdiction requires adequate protection measures or explicit consent.

policies.requirement_ref: UAE PDPL Articles 5-6 - Consent for processing
policies.requirement_description: Processing of personal data is only permitted with the clear and explicit consent of the data subject, or under specific lawful conditions.

policies.requirement_ref: Saudi PDPL Article 29 - Cross-border data transfer
policies.requirement_description: Personal data shall not be transferred outside the Kingdom unless adequate protections are in place and the transfer serves a purpose consistent with the original collection.

policies.requirement_ref: UAE National AI Strategy 2031 - AI governance principles
policies.requirement_description: AI systems must be developed and deployed in accordance with ethical principles, transparency requirements, and human oversight standards.
